claims.reason: The Google page shows that availability of some features depends on the device (Android version). It says nothing about dependence on the card (SIM or eSIM), nothing about SIM PIN settings, and nothing that names of settings vary between devices. The Apple page has no snapshot (blocked, 429).

scope_gaps.note: The Google advice to set a PIN, pattern or password is given for getting help from the Find Hub location network on Android, not as protection of a SIM; the SIM PIN part has no readable source.
The screen-lock quote concerns Android devices and Find Hub; nothing readable covers SIM or eSIM PIN use or other platforms.

The Google page covers Android devices and Wear OS watches (Find Hub), not other phones; the sentence says Google describes it and does not claim otherwise, so this is only what a reader might assume.
Only the Google page was checked; the claim about official documentation of devices and services also covers the Apple page, which has no snapshot.
Absence was checked only in the article region of the Google page (9122 of 11280 characters); the Apple page was not available for the same check.
The Google quotes concern Find Hub and IMEI feature availability by Android version, not SIM PIN settings; dependence on the card and the names of settings are not covered.
